program.title: WELDING PROGRAM
program.description: Our Welding Program prepares students with the skills, knowledge, and hands-on experience needed for successful careers in the welding industry.
features: Real-world projects and shop experience from day one.
Students learn SMAW, GMAW, GTAW, plasma cutting, and more.
Training with industry-standard equipment and tools.
Safety is our top priority in every class, every day.
We prepare students for high-demand careers in welding and manufacturing.

footer.tagline: High quality welding education. Real world skills. Real world careers.
